_about: On-screen text of the default story run that the story script editor (a private claude.ai page) edits: slides, the agents' chats, pointers (callouts) per beat, per-beat overrides of presenter notes and title cards, beats added in the editor, beats left out, and the closing line. Norwegian and English side by side. Spoken lines and their Norwegian subtitles stay in lines.json. content.js reads this file; web/scripts/story-editor/README.md says how edits come back from the editor.
